title.zh: 将甲米地省 Bacoor 市南他加禄地区医院床位由一百（100）张增至三百（300）张并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Southern Tagalog Regional Hospital in the City of Bacoor, Province of Cavite, From One Hundred (100) to Three Hundred (300) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Southern Tagalog Regional Hospital in the City of Bacoor, Province of Cavite, From One Hundred (100) to Three Hundred (300) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Vùng Southern Tagalog tại Thành phố Bacoor, Tỉnh Cavite từ 100 lên 300 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลภูมิภาค Southern Tagalog ในเมือง Bacoor จังหวัด Cavite จาก 100 เป็น 300 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Regional Southern Tagalog di Kota Bacoor, Provinsi Cavite dari 100 menjadi 300 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Wilayah Southern Tagalog di Bandar Bacoor, Wilayah Cavite daripada 100 kepada 300 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12213_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The authorized bed capacity of the Southern Tagalog Regional Hospital in the City of Bacoor, Province of Cavite, shall be increased from one hundred (100) to three (hundred (300) beds.

The existing professional healthcare services and facilities of the Southern Tagalog Regional Hospital shall also be upgraded to conform with and be commensurate to the increase in bed capacity as provided in Section 1 hereof.
The existing workforce of the Southern Tagalog Regional Hospital, which includes doctors, nurses, and support personnel, shall be increased correspondingly.

The Secretary of Health shall, after consultation with the Medical Center Chief of the Southern Tagalog Regional Hospital, and in coordination with the Secretary of Budget and Management and the Chairperson of the Civil Service Commission, determine the additional new positions to be created.
The Secretary of Health shall immediately include in the Department's program the implementation of this Act, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
If any provision of this Act is declared unconstitutional, the remaining parts of provisions not affected shall remain in full force and effect.
All laws, decrees, executive orders, issuances, and rules and regulations contrary to or inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
